coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: MB4E
record.summary: A 398-unit, two-phase affordable housing development at 1290 3rd St, on a currently-active surface parking lot between Mission Rock St and China Basin St -- built by Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services (as Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P.) under an OCII Exclusive Negotiating Agreement. Phase I (165 units, ~160 ft) fronts China Basin St; Phase II (233 units, ~225 ft) fronts Mission Rock St. Administratively separate from the Giants/Tishman Speyer Mission Rock masterplan despite sitting immediately adjacent to it.

facts.value: Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services, as Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P.
398 total: Phase I 165 units (163 affordable + 2 manager units, ~160 ft, China Basin St frontage); Phase II 233 units (231 affordable + 2 manager units, ~225 ft, Mission Rock St frontage)

All residential units (394 of 398, excluding 4 manager units) restricted to 70% AMI or below per the April 2026 CEQA Notice of Exemption -- this is the legally operative restriction. Earlier and secondary sources give different ranges (30-80% AMI per the 2024 ENA staff memo; ~35-95% AMI per the developer's own project site) -- see open_questions.
Approximately 1,253 sq ft ground-floor retail, Phase I

open_questions: Affordability figures differ across sources: the April 2026 CEQA Notice of Exemption (the most recent, legally binding source) restricts all 394 residential units to 70% AMI or below; the 2024 ENA staff memo cited 30-80% AMI; the developer's own project site (mb4e.com) still advertises 35% to ~95% AMI. The NOE is treated as authoritative here.

Construction start dates (Phase I early 2027, Phase II 2028) and completion targets (Phase I leasing 2029, Phase II completion ~2030) are sourced only to the developer's own project site, not yet confirmed by an OCII resolution or staff report -- flagged as expected/approximate.
OCII Resolution No. 04-2026 (Phase II predevelopment loan) is referenced in the Feb 2026 resolutions' recitals but was not independently read in this pass; its terms are not detailed here.
No public official's or community group's stated position on this project has been found and sourced.

record.notes: MB4E -- 398-unit, 100% affordable (30-95% AMI) two-phase development (Phase I: 165 units/16 stories fronting China Basin St; Phase II: 233 units/23 stories fronting Mission Rock St), plus ~1,250 sqft ground-floor retail, on a currently-active surface parking lot at 1290 3rd St between Mission Rock St and China Basin St. Developed by Curtis Development + Bayview Senior Services under SF's Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII) -- administratively separate from the Giants/Tishman Speyer Mission Rock masterplan (the Verde/Canyon rows above), despite sitting immediately adjacent to it and fronting a street literally named Mission Rock St. Per SF's own Spring 2026 development pipeline forecast, still in pre-construction bid-package phase as of that report; Phase I construction targeted to start early 2027, Phase II 2028 -- NOT yet under vertical construction as of this row's sourcing (2026-09-13), despite likely visible fencing/site-prep activity. NOTE: added after direct on-the-ground user observation of this parking lot; verified via SF OEWD's official pipeline forecast, OCII commission exhibits, and DataSF parcel records rather than assumed. (mb4e.com; sfyimby.com/2025/06/renderings-revealed-for-23-story-affordable-housing-in-mission-bay-san-francisco.html; media.api.sf.gov/documents/Spring_2026_DEV_Forecast.pdf)
